title: Objective and Subjective Diagnostic Parameters in the Fellow Eye of Unilateral Keratoconus
brief_summary: patients with keratoconus in one eye and forme fruste keratoconus in the fellow eye compared to normal subjects .the patients were examined by schemipflug imaging system (Pentacam)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with clinically evident keratoconus in one eye and apparently normal in the fellow eye

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous ocular surgery or truama,significant corneal scarring or associatedocular pathology
